verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single fixed dashboard that can be filtered and shared via links. Nothing documents saving individual insights or composing them into custom dashboards. Sharing the one standard dashboard is an adjacent feature, not the composable saved-insight dashboards the story asks for. Missing for 10: saved insights/reports, composing multiple saved insights into custom dashboards, sharing those composed dashboards with a team.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team

citations.quote: You get one dashboard with the essential website stats
Shared links: share your dashboard publicly or with specific people
share dashboards publicly or with anyone using a simple link
